state.paragraph: Also on October 7, 2013, Kirkland delivered to Goodwin Procter a revised draft of the merger agreement which, among other things, proposed a $15 million Mac-Gray termination fee, which represented approximately 4.4% of the total equity value of the transaction, and certain positions on the scope of various post-signing covenants.

ledger_rows.Note: Outside legal counsel to CSC/Pamplona; first named while receiving Mac-Gray's initial merger-agreement draft.
Resolved rollover relationship: talks permitted September 23 ended with no Moab rollover.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
